fullDescription: A high-performance dark editorial style tailored for digital agencies, fintech, and premium SaaS brands. This 'Midnight Editorial' aesthetic leverages deep blacks (#050505), high-contrast coral accents (#FF6B50), and sophisticated typography using the Satoshi variable font. The layout features a mix of brutalist-inspired massive display text (13vw) and minimalist glassmorphism elements, such as a floating bottom navigation dock. Key visual motifs include staggered grids, outline typography overlays, and grayscale imagery that transitions to full color on hover, creating a premium, tech-forward user experience optimized for conversion and storytelling.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated dark-mode editorial design featuring bold typography, a signature coral accent color, and high-end micro-interactions. The layout uses a fixed top navigation and a unique floating bottom dock, creating a modern application-like feel on a website.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-performance editorial aesthetic. Background: #050505. Accent Color: #FF6B50 (Coral). Text Colors: Primary #EBEBEB, Secondary #888888, Muted #444444. Typography: Use Satoshi Variable font. Headings should be bold with -0.05em letter-spacing. Display text (Hero) at 13vw. Use -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) for background outline text effects. Spacing: 8rem (128px) for section padding. Components: Use a glassmorphism effect (rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.8) with 12px blur) for navigation. Borders: 1px solid #333333. Hover Interactions: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for all transitions. Imagery: Default to grayscale with 60% opacity, transitioning to 100% opacity and color on hover with a 1.05x scale transform.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Top Navigation
Horizontal layout, fixed position. Left side: Small square logo container (32x32px) with sharp corners. Center: Hidden on mobile, desktop shows navigation links in 14px Satoshi Medium with #888888 color. Right side: 'Free Site Audit' text link and a secondary CTA button (px-5, py-2.5) with #1A1A1A background and #333333 border, swapping to white/black on hover.

### Floating Bottom Dock
Centered at the bottom (bottom-8). Glass container (rgba(17,17,17,0.8)) with 16px border-radius and 12px blur. Left side: Group of four icon-only buttons for services, separated by a right border (#333333). Right side: High-contrast primary CTA button in #FF6B50 with black bold uppercase text. Icons should use Lucide-style thin weights.

### Hero Section
100vh height. Background: Radial gradient (#1a1a1a at center to #050505 at 70%). Center: Massive display text '/scale' in white bold italic-none. Layered behind it: 'SYNTAX' in transparent outline text (13vw). Bottom Left: Avatar stack of 3 team members (40px circles, grayscale, 2px border) followed by 'Engineered for performance' text. Bottom Right: Underlined email address acting as a secondary contact point.

### Strategy / Benefits Section
Two-column grid with a large header. Header: 72px font-size with specific emphasis on 'search dominance'. Card 1 (Left): #111111 background, 40px border-radius, 520px height. Text 'React & Next' in 72px bold white, secondary text 'Zero Bloat' in #444444. Card 2 (Right): Gradient background (#FF6B50 to #E55A40). Contains a 'Mini-Dashboard' UI element with a 6-bar chart showing growth trends.

### Project Gallery
2-column grid. Right-side column is offset vertically by 96px (mt-24). Each card: Aspect ratio 4:3, grayscale image (60% opacity) that scales 5% on hover. Metadata below image: 30px bold title, 10px uppercase tracking-widest category (e.g., SEO Strategy / SaaS). Include a circular 'arrow-up-right' icon that turns coral on hover.

### CTA Footer
Top border: 1px #1A1A1A. Content: Massive display text 'START DOMINATING.' (14vw) in white. Below: 40px font-size email address. Right side: Social media cluster using 56px circular buttons with #333333 borders, icons center-aligned. Hover state: White background, black icon, -8px Y-axis translation.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Mini-Dashboard Benefit Card — A card that visualizes growth using a simplified bar chart UI.
Container: Gradient #FF6B50 to #E55A40 with 40px radius. Inner UI: #050505 rounded rectangle (12px radius). Header of inner UI: Two coral dots and a progress bar placeholder. Graph: 6 vertical bars of varying heights. One bar (4th or 5th) must be #FF6B50 and taller than the others. Footer of inner UI: '+312% Growth' in 10px coral bold text.

### Glass Dock Navigation — A floating navigation bar that houses primary service icons and a main CTA.
Fixed bottom-8, left-1/2, -translate-x-1/2. Background: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.8) with backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Border: 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Padding: 8px. Border-radius: 20px. Left section: Icon buttons with 12px padding, #222222 hover state. Right section: CTA button in #FF6B50, 24px horizontal padding, 12px vertical padding, font-weight 800.

### Outline Overlay Typography — High-impact display text layered behind filled text.
Positioning: Absolute center. Base layer: font-size 13vw, -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), color: transparent, select-none. Top layer: font-size 13vw, color: white, font-weight: 800, line-height: 0.9.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-mode editorial design featuring bold typography, a signature coral accent color, and high-end micro-interactions. The layout uses a fixed top navigation and a unique floating bottom dock, creating a modern application-like feel on a website.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Midnight' color palette and editorial typography. It uses Satoshi as the primary typeface for a clean yet authoritative look. Primary color is #050505 (Deep Black), secondary is #111111 (Off-Black), and the primary accent is #FF6B50 (Coral). Animations include subtle floating effects, smooth scaling on hover (cubic-bezier 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), and radial gradient overlays to create depth without using heavy shadows. Text often features tight letter-spacing (-0.05em) and varies between filled and outline styles to create visual hierarchy.
